discovery-session.label: Discovery session
discovery-session.description: For discovery workshops and requirements sessions: decisions, action items with owners and due dates, open questions, risks and constraints, the requirements heard with quotes, and coverage of the checklist and agenda.

prompts.SUMMARY:
The following is the transcript of a meeting. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{transcript}


Write a concise summary of the meeting without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns.
prompts.DECISIONS:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{timed_transcript}


List each decision the meeting made, in the order made, in this Markdown format:

- **[The decision, in one sentence]** - Decided by: [the names of who decided, as said, or "not stated"]. Applies: [when it takes effect or for what period, as said, or "not stated"]. Time: [the [MM:SS] mark of the line where it was decided]

A decision is something the participants agreed, or that someone with the authority to decide stated as settled; a proposal nobody agreed to is not a decision. If no decision was made, respond with exactly: No decisions were made in this meeting.

Write the list in clean Markdown without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns. Use only what the transcript says; never guess a name, a date or a decision.
prompts.ACTION ITEMS:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{timed_transcript}


List each action item agreed or assigned in the meeting, in this Markdown format:

- **[What is to be done, in one sentence]** - Owner: [the name of who is to do it, as said, or "no owner"]. Due: [the due date or time as said, or "no due date"]. Time: [the [MM:SS] mark of the line where it was agreed]

Write "no owner" when the transcript does not say who will do it, and "no due date" when it does not say when. If there are no action items, respond with exactly: No action items were agreed in this meeting.

Write the list in clean Markdown without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns. Use only what the transcript says; never guess a name, a date or a decision.
prompts.OPEN QUESTIONS:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{timed_transcript}


List each question raised in the meeting that was not answered by the end of it, in this Markdown format:

- **[The question]** - Who should answer: [the name or role the transcript says should answer it, or "not stated"]. Asked by: [the name of who asked it]. Time: [the [MM:SS] mark of the line where it was asked]

If every question raised was answered, respond with exactly: No open questions remain.

Write the list in clean Markdown without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns. Use only what the transcript says; never guess a name, a date or a decision.
prompts.RISKS AND CONSTRAINTS:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{timed_transcript}


List each risk, dependency, constraint or blocker that was raised in the meeting, in this Markdown format:

- **[The risk or constraint, in one sentence]** - Raised by: [the name of who raised it]. Time: [the [MM:SS] mark of the line where it was raised]

Include budget, timeline, technical, legal and staffing constraints only when they were said. If none was raised, respond with exactly: No risks or constraints were raised.

Write the list in clean Markdown without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns. Use only what the transcript says; never guess a name, a date or a decision.
prompts.REQUIREMENTS HEARD:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{timed_transcript}


List each requirement a participant stated: something the solution, product or outcome must or should do, support or meet. Use this Markdown format:

- **[The requirement, as a short statement]** - Speaker: [the name of who said it]. Time: [the [MM:SS] mark of the line]
> [A quote of what they said, copied word for word from that line, at most 200 characters]

List only requirements that were said. Never infer a requirement from the topic of the meeting or from what is usual, and never change the words inside a quote; shorten a long line by stopping the quote early rather than paraphrasing it. If no requirement was stated, respond with exactly: No requirements were stated in this meeting.

Write the list in clean Markdown without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns. Use only what the transcript says; never guess a name, a date or a decision.
prompts.CHECKLIST COVERAGE:
The following is the transcript of a meeting, with the time of each line from the start of the meeting. A line in parentheses marks where the shared screen changed. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{timed_transcript}


The meeting's checklist, one numbered item per line with its status as recorded during the meeting and the times of its evidence, was:

{checklist}


For each checklist item, in checklist order, write one line in this Markdown format:

- **[Checklist item]**: Covered | Partial | Open - [a few words on what was said] (evidence: [the [MM:SS] marks of the lines that show it, or "none"])

Mark an item Covered only if the transcript shows it was fully addressed, Partial if it was raised but not finished, and Open if it was not discussed. An item the checklist records as covered or deferred keeps that status unless the transcript shows otherwise.

Write the list in clean Markdown without preamble or additional explanation. Where possible reference speaker names, but only use gender neutral pronouns. Use only what the transcript says; never guess a name, a date or a decision.
prompts.AGENDA COVERAGE:
The following is the transcript of a meeting. Lines that begin with [chat] were typed in the meeting chat rather than spoken.

{transcript}


The meeting's agenda was:

{agenda}


For each agenda item, in agenda order, write one line in the following Markdown format, without preamble or additional explanation:

- **[Agenda item]**: Covered | Partly covered | Not covered - [a few words on what was discussed or decided]

Mark an item Covered only if the transcript shows it was discussed and concluded, Partly covered if it was raised but not finished, and Not covered if it was not discussed. If no agenda items are listed between the agenda tags, respond with exactly: No agenda was set for this meeting.
